summary: Flatter eastern end of a residential kerb; homes 12-19 m away on this side.
reasons: Flattest part of a steep street

best_section.where: North kerb at the eastern end, approaching the main road junction

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 12 m away at about 99 m, houses 19 m away at 114 m; trees screen the frontage.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars parked along it; room at the kerb before the junction.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street, but the junction with a busy road is at the end.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs give 2P parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 3.7% in the section, 7.8% mean along the stretch
sun_shade: Dense trees shade the kerb from the north and west.
cannot_judge: Whether the corner is clear of the junction
